description: This file defines data structures and functions for handling configuration schema nodes, UI hints, and path segments, including parsing, validation, and utility functions.

classes.name: ConfigUiHint
classes.description: Represents UI hints for configuration fields, initialized from raw dictionary data.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaNode
classes.description: Represents a node in a configuration schema, with properties for schema attributes and methods for navigation.

methods.name: decodeUiHints
methods.description: Decodes a dictionary of raw UI hints into a dictionary of ConfigUiHint objects.

methods.name: hintForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the most relevant UI hint for a given configuration path from a hints dictionary.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path points to sensitive information based on key names.

methods.name: pathKey
methods.description: Generates a string key from a configuration path for lookup purposes.
